verses.verse:
लयः स कथ्यते कालः यस्त्वाघातैर्नियन्त्रितः।
मिताघातस्तु तालः स्यात् सून्य विभाजितः।९८।
verses.text: That time which is regulated by strokes is called laya (tempo); and [laya] with a measured number of strokes, divided by empty [beats], is tāla (metric cycle).

commentary.text: That is, when we regulate the flow of time with regular strokes, that very time is given the name laya (tempo). And when we limit those strokes to a fixed number and divide them with khālī (empty) claps, it is called tāla (metric cycle). Laya is essential in every tāla, but tāla is not necessary in every laya. If laya is the flower, tāla is the garland made of them.
